checks.label: Accessibility Services Enabled
checks.description: Accessibility services can monitor all input and screen content
checks.remediation: Disable unused accessibility services in Settings > Accessibility. Only keep services you actively need.

checks.label: Touch Exploration
checks.remediation: Disable touch exploration in Settings > Accessibility if not needed for assistive use.

checks.label: High Text Contrast
checks.remediation: Review high contrast setting in Settings > Accessibility > Display. No security risk - informational only.

checks.label: Screen Magnification
checks.remediation: Review magnification in Settings > Accessibility. No security risk - informational only.

checks.label: Default Input Method
checks.remediation: Verify the default input method is the stock keyboard. Change in Settings > System > Languages and input.

checks.label: Enabled Input Methods
checks.description: All enabled input methods - third party keyboards can log keystrokes
checks.remediation: Remove untrusted input methods in Settings > System > Languages and input > On-screen keyboard.

checks.label: Spell Checker Enabled
checks.description: Spell checker may send typed text to cloud
checks.remediation: Disable spell checker in Settings > System > Languages and input if cloud-based text processing is a concern.

checks.label: Voice Input Service
checks.remediation: Review voice input service in Settings > Apps. Disable or revoke permissions for unused voice input services.

checks.label: No 3rd party keyboards installed
checks.remediation: Uninstall third-party keyboard apps via Settings > Apps or use adb uninstall <package-name>.

checks.label: Enabled IMEs Holding INTERNET Permission
checks.command: IMES=$(settings get secure enabled_input_methods 2>/dev/null | tr ':' '\n' | sed 's|/.*||' | sort -u | grep -v '^$' | grep -vE '^(com\.google\.android|com\.android|com\.samsung|com\.sec\.android)'); HITS=''; for pkg in $IMES; do if dumpsys package "$pkg" 2>/dev/null | grep -q 'android.permission.INTERNET'; then HITS="$HITS $pkg"; fi; done; echo $HITS | sed 's/^ //'
checks.description: Enumerates enabled third-party input methods (IMEs) and reports the ones that declare android.permission.INTERNET. A keyboard with network access can exfiltrate keystrokes (passwords, PHI, card data). Pre-installed Google/Samsung/AOSP IMEs are excluded because they legitimately hold INTERNET for cloud features and would otherwise fire on every consumer device. A non-empty result means a sideloaded or third-party keyboard can reach the network - investigate it.
checks.remediation: Disable network-capable IMEs in Settings > System > Languages and input > On-screen keyboard, or uninstall them. For locked-down deployments use an offline-only keyboard with no INTERNET permission.

checks.label: Physical Keyboard Layout Overrides
checks.description: secure.keyboard_layouts records per-device keyboard layout overrides for attached USB/Bluetooth keyboards. On a kiosk or POS terminal with no physical keyboard this should be empty. A non-empty value means an external HID device was attached and remapped at some point, which is worth investigating on dedicated-function devices.
checks.remediation: If the device should not accept external keyboards, clear the override ('settings delete secure keyboard_layouts') and block USB HID via USB host policy or kiosk lockdown.

checks.label: Clipboard Auto-Clear Timeout (Android 13+)
checks.command: T=$(settings get global clipboard_auto_clear_timeout 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$T" ] || [ "$T" = "null" ]; then echo 'DEFAULT'; else echo "$T"; fi
checks.description: Android 13+ auto-clears the primary clipboard after roughly one hour on most OEM builds. Value reported in milliseconds when explicitly set. DEFAULT means the OEM default is in force. A value of 0 disables auto-clear entirely, leaving copied OTPs, passwords and card numbers in the clipboard until manually overwritten.
checks.remediation: Leave at the OEM default or set a short timeout. Avoid 0 (disabled). For PIN-pad terminals, also enable 'Clipboard Access Notification' under PRIVACY.
